_meta.description: FacetSchema summarising a filtered customers cohort's region distribution decorated with an OVERLAY_CHISQ_VS_POP scalar overlay that runs a chi-square goodness-of-fit test of the host subset's per-value distribution against the resolver-supplied population frequencies (an unfiltered or alternately-filtered comparison cohort). FACET-host inferential sibling of the discrete-arm streamable OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_POP (10_facet_index_vs_pop.json) and OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_POP (21_facet_zscore_vs_pop.json). Emits one scalar OverlaySummary{Statistic, PValue, Parameters{df}} carrying the table-level test result — the renderer surfaces it as a distributional-shift badge near the facet header. Low-expected-cell warning follows the canonical chi-square rule (any expected < 5 → one PULSE_OVERLAY_EXPECTED_LOW warning). Inherently buffered (inferential FACET-host family).
_meta.name: facet-chisq-vs-pop
